'''Thorsten Libotte''' (born 20 July 1972 in [[Bonn]]) is a German writer and poet.<ref>[https://books.google.com/books?id=_DS3oAEACAAJ&q=K%C3%BCrschners+Deutscher+Literatur-Kalender+2014 ''Thorsten Libotte.''] In: ''[[Kürschners Deutscher Literatur-Kalender]] 2014/2015: Band I: A-O. Band II: P-Z.'', [[Verlag Walter de Gruyter]] Incorporated, 2014, p. 631–632 {{ISBN|978-3-11-033720-4}}</ref>

== Life and career ==
Thorsten Libotte was born 1972 in Bonn ([[North Rhine-Westphalia]]). After graduating from high school and subsequent military duty he began his biology studies at the [[University of Bonn|Rheinische Friedrich-Wilhelms-Universität Bonn]] in the fall of 1992.<ref>Biographical details of ''Thorsten Libotte.'' In: ''Quintessenz.'', Martin Werhand Verlag, 2014, p. 115</ref> In the spring of 2001 he moved to the [[University of Cologne]] to research as a doctoral fellow at the Faculty of Medicine and received his PhD in the summer of 2004.<ref>[http://kups.ub.uni-koeln.de/view/creators/Libotte=3AThorsten=3A=3A.html Thorsten Libotte at ''University of Cologne'']</ref>

In addition to normal studies and professional activities, he developed his talent as a writer. Since the late 1990s, he is represented as a poet with various publications in numerous poetry anthologies, including three volumes of the Young Poetry Series ''Junge Lyrik'' at the [[Martin Werhand Verlag]].<ref>[http://www.ksta.de/junge-zeiten/junge-lyrik,16129136,14033596.html ''Kölner Stadt-Anzeiger'', 23. Juli 2004].</ref> Furthermore, he contributed to the classic series ''Gedichte zur Weihnacht'' at the [[Reclam]] Verlag publishing house under supervision of editor [[Stephan Koranyi]].<ref>[http://www.reclam.de/detail/978-3-15-010719-5?query=gedichte+zur+weihnacht ''Thorsten Libotte.'' In: ''Gedichte zur Weihnacht.'', Reclam Verlag, Ditzingen, 2009, p. 188]</ref>

In 2006 the [[Bremer Straßenbahn]] AG under the direction of Dr. Joachim Tuz started a visual lyrical project called ''Poetry in Motion (Poesie bewegt)'' with many modern authors and their contemporary poems, Thorsten Libotte among them.<ref>[http://www.poesiebewegt.de/liste.html ''Thorsten Libotte.'' In: ''Poesie bewegt.''] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140904143832/http://www.poesiebewegt.de/liste.html |date=September 4, 2014 }}</ref>

In March 2014 his own first book of poetry ''Quintessenz'' appeared in the series ''100 Gedichte'' at [[Martin Werhand Verlag]]. His second poetry book was published in the same year under the name ''Mitbürger''.<ref>[https://books.google.com/books?id=pJDEoAEACAAJ&q=%22Thorsten+Libotte%22 ''Mitbürger.'', Martin Werhand Verlag, Melsbach, 2014, p. 135]</ref> His third book of poems ''Zapping'' appeared in the series ''250 Gedichte'' and was published at Martin Werhand Verlag in November 2015.<ref>[http://www.martinwerhandverlag.de/publikationen/ ''Thorsten Libotte.'' In: ''Martin Werhand Verlag.'', Publikationen 2015]</ref>

Thorsten Libotte is father of two kids and lives with his family in [[Ruppichteroth]].<ref>Biographical details of ''Thorsten Libotte.'' In: ''Mitbürger.'', Martin Werhand Verlag, 2014, p. 115</ref>
